name: Srujan Iyengar
headline: Systems, backend and infrastructure engineering
intro: I work on isolation, Kubernetes security and the automation and tests around them.

experience.summary: Multi-tenant microVM sandbox on k3s with Kata Containers, Cloud Hypervisor and Cilium.
bullets: Fail-closed CEL admission policies that enforce the Kata runtime class and reject token automount.
Enabled Kata guest seccomp; ran the Cloud Hypervisor VMM as non-root.
Root-caused Kata VM memory escaping cgroup limits and fixed it.
Identity-based Cilium policies for tenant isolation.
Test harness that enforces threat-to-test coverage both ways, gated in CI by a Go merge gate.

experience.summary: Go microservice with a rate limiter, a worker-pool pipeline and DAG orchestration.

projects.name: Lab Control Plane
projects.summary: Node.js/Fastify service that places and reaps lab pods across k3s clusters, with idempotency, rollback, capacity-aware placement and Prometheus metrics.
